title: OWL sync vault (bounded inventory for LP-sync keepers)

request.objective:
OmniSyncVault on Ethereum: a bounded inventory vault for LP-sync keepers of OWL (the bridged twin of pump.fun coin 8QtbrC9d3BezyCwzBFUQbNsWJGte7ckrZ7HWcn81pump). Keepers trade the one OWL/ETH Uniswap v4 pool against the Solana pool and move inventory over Wormhole NTT; the vault lets depositors fund them without handing over keys. Constructor arguments: PoolManager and the pool key (token OWL, ETH, fee 10000, tick spacing 200, the OmniPoolHook), TOKEN, NTT_MANAGER (the Wormhole NttManager), SOLANA_RECIPIENT (a 32-byte Solana address that receives every bridge transfer), KEEPER_CAP = 5.

No token is created: shares are internal accounting in the vault, not an ERC-20, not transferable, with no name, symbol or supply. Depositors. deposit() payable and depositToken(amount) credit shares: ETH shares and OWL shares are two separate claims, each over its own balance, so the vault never values the token in ETH through a price feed. withdraw(ethShares, tokenShares) pays out pro rata at any time, never more than the vault holds right now; funds that are away on the Solana side are claimed when they return. No fee on deposits or withdrawals.

Keepers. The owner 0x6c4c78f2c3bdf4c4318fe305fb1c8bc1694d19b5 adds up to KEEPER_CAP keeper addresses (addKeeper, removeKeeper; removal is immediate). A keeper can only: (1) swap exactly through the one pool with the vault's own funds, each swap at most MAX_SWAP = 2 ETH (or the same value in OWL, measured by the swap itself), at most 10 ETH of volume per rolling 24 hours, with a minimum output the keeper passes; the vault requires its total value in ETH terms (ETH balance plus OWL balance priced at the pool's price after the swap) not to fall by more than 0.5% of the vault's value per swap and 3% per 24 hours, otherwise the swap reverts; (2) send OWL to SOLANA_RECIPIENT through NTT_MANAGER.transfer (at most 500,000 OWL per transfer and 2,000,000 per 24 hours), never to any other address or chain; (3) trigger receipt of what NTT delivers to the vault. A keeper cannot withdraw, approve, or send anything to an address that is not the pool, the NTT manager or SOLANA_RECIPIENT. Keepers earn KEEPER_BPS = 2000 (20%) of the vault's realised profit in ETH terms, measured against a high-water mark, paid on harvest(); losses are shared by depositors.

Safety. The owner can pause keepers (pauseKeepers), never deposits or withdrawals, and cannot change SOLANA_RECIPIENT, the pool, NTT_MANAGER, caps or KEEPER_BPS: they are immutable. No upgrade, no sweep or rescue function. Events for every deposit, withdrawal, swap, bridge send, receipt and harvest. Foundry tests on a real v4-core PoolManager and a mock NttManager: every cap at its exact boundary, a keeper trying to send to another address, a swap that loses more than 0.5%, share maths with fuzz, withdrawal while funds are away, pause, harvest with the high-water mark, reentrancy.
